description: Detects unauthorized modifications to critical system files by comparing against a known-good baseline database. Scheduled or continuous monitoring of /etc, /bin, /sbin, /usr.

cvss_vector_impacts.rationale: Compensating control: file modifications detected, alerting triggered

verification.method: Verify AIDE is installed and database is initialized

remediation.name: AIDE file integrity monitoring with systemd timer

steps.description: Initialize the AIDE database from the current filesystem state; this overwrites any existing baseline
Create a systemd service and daily timer for automated integrity checks
steps.command:
printf '[Unit]
Description=AIDE integrity check

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/aide --check
' > /etc/systemd/system/aide-check.service && printf '[Unit]
Description=Daily AIDE integrity check

[Timer]
OnCalendar=daily
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
' > /etc/systemd/system/aide-check.timer && systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now aide-check.timer
steps.undo: systemctl disable --now aide-check.timer && rm -f /etc/systemd/system/aide-check.service /etc/systemd/system/aide-check.timer && systemctl daemon-reload

references.source: RHEL 9 Security Hardening — Checking integrity with AIDE
CIS RHEL 9 Benchmark — 1.3 Filesystem Integrity Checking
